reserveReview.rationale: Renewed 2026-10-27. The Frax frxUSD balance-sheet API (asOfTimestamp 2026-10-27T16:03:47Z) was re-read for the upstream frxUSD record. The EIP-1967 beacon 0x251d07287c12707418a414b2c95436b4216b7bf4 returns implementation 0xd2478f5db285e7d4f1a260c9f142168124d02370. Its verified full source burns caller-owned USSD and transfers idle frxUSD atomically; isolatedBackingEnabled=false, router=0, redeemFee=0 re-read at the new block. Immediate describes availability of the entire direct frxUSD position under the local withdrawal mechanism, not sale at a guaranteed USD price or final bank settlement. Owner recovery, isolation activation, token freeze and upgrade powers remain separate adverse controls; parent reserves and fiat redemption remain inherited.
